itemGroup.abyssfall.head: Abyss
item.abyssfall.fake_infinity_sword.tribu: Hold Shift to read the inscription
Twelve years ago, the power of the universe took the form of a divine sword, leaving a profound impression on me in my youth.
“So even in a world of pixels, it was possible to wield a sword this magnificent.”
However, while developing AbyssFall, I revisited the rendering mechanics behind this sword, and discovered something unexpected:
The divine sword forged from the power of the universe twelve years ago was not rendered entirely as its creator had envisioned.

The development environment of that era was vastly different from what we have today, and the rendering system of the time contained subtle flaws that are difficult to notice from a modern perspective.
And yet, the Sword of the Cosmos left an indelible mark on my memory.
I want those who once experienced Avaritia to see once again the weapon that perhaps best represented Morpheus1101’s original artistic vision—
the way it was meant to look.
“This sword has endured through the Eternal Age. The power of the universe has long since faded, yet the blade still reflects the cosmos.”
“The fury of the universe in the palm of your hand.”
A tribute to the person who once created the world of Avaritia.
And this is also one of the reasons I became a programmer.
I, too, want to create a world in which players can truly lose themselves.
